# Ghidra distribution

The preview release carries the unchanged official Ghidra 12.1.2 archive (572,803,866 bytes), with its embedded third-party licenses preserved. Verify the SHA-256 in manifest.json before extracting. Existing healthy installations are reused. JDK and platform dependencies are not included.

This archive is an optional static analysis tool distribution; it does not establish universal reconstruction or full tool-suite completeness.
